claims.result: Gas masses ~0.01-0.1 Msun and gas-to-dust ratios ~80-530
claims.finding: High ratios may indicate grain growth and drift, but continuum optical thickness makes them upper limits

claims.hypothesis: Inner dust cavities bias line-based gas masses
claims.experiment: Re-fit six T Tauri disks with cavity models
claims.result: Gas mass decreases in all cases, within a factor ~2.5
claims.finding: The cavity effect is typically small

evidence.loc: 5.2 The effect of an inner dust cavity

referee_caveats_inferred: Gas-to-dust ratios depend on an assumed 20 K and a single opacity while the continuum may be optically thick
Result depends on a model grid published in a companion paper (in press), with no sampler or convergence details given
Kinematic masses are treated as truth though they carry their own systematics and several are upper limits
Midplane ionization rate and N2 abundance are degenerate and N2 is held fixed
Sample is mixed between archival data of different resolutions and aperture choices

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: About 20 ALMA projects (Band 6/7, multi-execution-block, several long-baseline); raw data likely well over 1 TB, calibrated products several hundred GB
reproducibility.score_reason: Data are public and flux tables plus Zenodo model fluxes are given, but the fitting machinery and grid come from a companion paper and key imaging/aperture parameters are not given.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Recipe depends on an external thermochemical grid and MCMC setup from an in-press paper, so the main gas masses cannot be redone from this paper alone.
